chapter.name: Grafana & Friends Mumbai
chapter.description: A free community meetup for developers, SREs and DevOps engineers in Mumbai, supported by Grafana Labs. We get together to talk about metrics, logs, traces, profiling and the things that break in production.

mascot.name: Grot
mascot.title: Official Grafana & Community Mascot
mascot.bio: Grot is Grafana's beloved explorer mascot. With a glowing visor and curiosity for metrics, logs, traces, and profiles, Grot guides observability adventurers through complex distributed architectures.
mascot.quote: "May your queries be fast, your dashboards clear, and your latency low!"

tips.tip: Use rate() on counters with a time window at least 4x your scrape interval to avoid noisy spikes caused by missed scrapes.
Filter high-volume logs with stream selectors first (e.g. {env='prod', app='gateway'}) before running heavy regex or line extraction.
Pinpoint latency bottlenecks by querying traces with { duration > 500ms && status = error } for immediate root cause discovery.
Continuous profiling with Pyroscope reveals CPU flame graphs across production without degrading system throughput.
Anchor your primary SRE dashboards on the 4 Golden Signals: Latency, Traffic, Errors, and Saturation.

tracks.title: Metrics, Dashboards & Alerting
tracks.description: Learn to query high-throughput time-series data with PromQL, visualize custom data sources with Grafana plugins, and configure multi-channel alerts.

tracks.title: High-Velocity Log Aggregation
tracks.description: Explore horizontal log aggregation using Grafana Loki. Learn structured metadata, regex label extraction, and pinpointing exceptions from millions of lines.

tracks.title: Distributed Tracing & OpenTelemetry
tracks.description: Instrument cloud-native microservices with OpenTelemetry SDKs, collect distributed spans via Grafana Alloy, and trace cross-service bottlenecks in Tempo.

tracks.title: eBPF Telemetry & Continuous Profiling
tracks.description: Harness Linux eBPF with Grafana Beyla for auto-instrumentation without code changes, and analyze CPU/memory flame graphs down to the line of code.

faqs.question: What is Grafana & Friends Mumbai and how can I join?
faqs.answer: Grafana & Friends Mumbai is the official local chapter for developers, SREs, DevOps engineers and students who care about observability. Join the group on Meetup.com and you will be notified of every in-person and virtual meetup.

faqs.question: Is attending the meetups free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every meetup, workshop and event is free and open to everyone. Grafana Labs and our community partners cover the costs.

faqs.question: How can I become a speaker or present a talk?
faqs.answer: We welcome talks at every experience level. A 10-minute lightning demo or a 30-minute deep dive on metrics, logs, traces or incident response all work. Send a proposal through the Call for Speakers form.

faqs.question: What is the format and typical agenda of a meetup?
faqs.answer: A typical meetup has 2 or 3 technical talks, hands-on demos, Q&A, a quiz with swag, and time to talk over food and drinks.

faqs.question: Can my company sponsor or host a future meetup?
faqs.answer: Yes. We are always looking for venues, sponsors, and food or swag partners in Mumbai. Email the organising team at grafanamumbai@gmail.com.

faqs.question: What Code of Conduct applies to community events?
faqs.answer: We follow the Grafana Events Code of Conduct and the Contributor Covenant, so events stay safe, inclusive and free of harassment.
